data.narrative:
Flamefront Propulsion is a pre-seed stage defense and security company founded by Matt Garcia, an MIT-trained aeronauticist and former founding engineer and head of propulsion at Mach Industries. The broader Defense & Security sector includes 26 comparable companies, with a public comp universe of 2 (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and private comps numbering 8, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Standard peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. The available comp set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers with similar valuation tiers—only 0 same-stage datapoints, 1 adjacent-stage datapoint, and 0 similar-tier datapoints were identified. Conventional triangulation therefore requires at least 3 comparable observations within a narrow band; this threshold was not met. Expanding the filter to all 26 Defense & Security peers would introduce unacceptable heterogeneity in stage, revenue, and capital intensity and risks producing misleading guidance.

Without sufficient comparable transactions at pre-seed stage in this sector, valuation cannot be reliably anchored to market comparables. Alternative methods—including venture cost-of-capital, discounted cash flow (where revenue visibility permits), or founder/team-backed structural analysis—would be required to establish a defensible range. The scarcity of pre-seed benchmarks in advanced defense technology remains the binding constraint on quantitative valuation support.
